notes.title: Final days of the Summer Sale
notes.notes:
Trixxy has been the talk of Capital City since the discovery of the Phantom Train. Almost a year has past and the mystery is still fresh on everyone's mind. 

What have you been waiting for, citizen?! The Phantom Train has pulled up to the station and is awaiting for you to climb aboard. Take a seat, pick up your copy, and play through the journey of Trixxy, the famous hacker mage. Experience the spooky abandoned subway, collect the clues, piece together the story, and stop your adversary from claiming the train's power as their own!

Don't miss out on the Reaper's generosity to bestow upon you insights into their greatest victory or defeat. The only way to find out is by discovering it for yourself...are you prepared for the challenge?

notes.title: Patch 1.1 and Cyber Monday Sale
notes.notes:
[b][u]Incident Report[/u][/b]

Trixxy has become rather unpredictable and caught us off guard by hacking into the mainframe. She's not only made improvements to the railways, but also is cutting a deal for all of her fans. Such behavior is unacceptable, but the damage is done and we're cleaning up the mess. Until we're able to correct this, enjoy the upgrade and discount because we strive to make sure it's your last.

Patch Notes:
- Minor bug fixes
- Change some text display
- Added text history function

Signed,
- The Reapers

notes.title: 1 Month Steam Release Anniversary!
notes.notes:
Trixxy has been exploring these old railways for almost a month and hasn't had much to show for it. Until now! She has discovered an amazing deal of 15% off and wishes to share it with everyone!

We, the Reapers, harbor a cold appreciation for those who have participated in Trixxy's adventure so far.
Therefore, we shall allow this to pass, but not without a sacrifice! You see, we've removed the Demo, but you won't need the likes of it anymore once you've acquired Trixxy's full story, eh? Be sure to get your hands on this soon, though, because our generosity will only last for so long.

[u][b]This special promotion begins on August 19th at 10:00am and lasts until August 22nd at 10:00am.[/b][/u]

Thank you for your support and we look forward to the enjoyment you derive from the remainder of Trixxy's adventure.
